name: Dissonance
source:
Dissonance is an on-going visual novel where you follow Toru Hirai as he attempts to readjust to his life after a coma.  Throughout the story, you'll find yourself interacting with and deepening your connections with several characters as you explore Ametohi. And there's no need to be picky about where you go and when, after all, you'll have plenty of time!

[From [url=https://l-elyot.itch.io/dissonance]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《不和谐》是一部正在进行中的视觉小说，你将跟随平井彻在昏迷后试图重新适应自己的生活。在整个故事中，当你探索阿梅托希时，你会发现自己与多个角色互动并加深了与他们的联系。而且无需挑剔去哪里和何时去，毕竟，你有充足的时间！

[来自[url=https://l-elyot.itch.io/dissonance]itch.io[/url]]
